structured_output.rationale: All 5 lines denied CO-4/N822: therapy CPTs 97530, 97140, 97116 billed with KX only — GP/GO/GN discipline modifier absent. Medicare Part B unprocessable (no appeal rights); remedy is a new original claim with GP appended to each line. DOS 2026-06-05, filed 2026-06-24, well within the 1-year Medicare window.

root_cause.explanation: All 5 lines carry only KX. CPTs 97530, 97140, and 97116 require a discipline modifier (GP for PT plan of care). CO-4/N822 = returned unprocessable; no appeal rights.

next_action.detail: Submit a new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) adding GP to every line alongside KX. Do not appeal — unprocessable claims have no appeal rights and redetermination will be dismissed while the filing clock runs.

evidence.fact: Lines 1–5: CO-4 ($330.73 total) with RARC N822 on therapy CPTs 97530, 97140, 97116
Modifiers on claim: KX only — no GP, GO, or GN on any line
PT treatment note confirms physical therapy services under a PT plan of care, requiring GP modifier
CO-4/N822 on therapy CPTs = unprocessable; remedy is new original CLM05-3=1 with discipline modifier appended

citations.rule: CO-4/N822 on always-therapy CPTs = missing discipline modifier; new original claim with GP/GO/GN; no appeal rights
